description: Answer an OPEN delegation as the human — same as 'Antworten senden' in the tab: writes each answer, status answered, answered_at; the Dev-Agent session that asked is then resumed the usual way (runner pick-up). Every question needs an answer (earlier answers are kept). Only the person themselves: refused while an agent is active (work_as_agent). Permission questions (kind permission): give permission once | always | group | deny — exactly the tab's four buttons; free text does not apply. Mail drafts in questions are NOT sent; the agent sends after its own approval rule.

answers.description: One entry per question (question ids from get_user_delegation).

question_id.description: Permission question to answer when there are several; default the first.

name: answer_user_delegation
